proposed_widenings.name: choose_effect_dispatch
proposed_widenings.justification: Channel Divinity is a use-count pool whose activation lets the player choose one of several registered sub-effects. No existing ClassFeatureMechanics family supports a 'choose one from list' dispatcher — the 'activation' family has a single effect field and no branching.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you use this class's Channel Divinity, choose which Channel Divinity effect from this class to create.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost: action
proposed_widenings.justification: Both Divine Spark and Turn Undead cost a Magic action (one of the 12 standard action kinds). ClassFeatureActivationCost only models 'free' and 'bonus_action' — no 'action' variant exists.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you point your Holy Symbol at another creature... / As a Magic action, you present your Holy Symbol and censure Undead creatures.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect: damage (with save_gate)
proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Spark's damage branch requires a Constitution saving throw followed by full or half Necrotic/Radiant damage. ClassFeatureEffect has only GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect — no damage variant and no save_gate resolution.
proposed_widenings.evidence: force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice) equal to that total. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect: player_choice branch (heal vs. damage)
proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Spark offers a runtime player-choice between healing and damage at activation. This is not a save branch (caster decides, not a roll outcome). There is no 'player_choice' discriminant anywhere in the ClassFeature family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You either restore Hit Points to the creature equal to that total or force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect: apply_conditions (area, multi-condition)
proposed_widenings.justification: Turn Undead applies Frightened + Incapacitated simultaneously to all chosen Undead that fail a Wisdom save within a 30 ft area. ClassFeatureEffect has no condition application, no area scoping, and the Condition type only includes 'prone'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each Undead of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its save, it has the Frightened and Incapacitated conditions for 1 minute.

proposed_widenings.name: Condition: frightened, incapacitated
proposed_widenings.justification: Turn Undead applies two conditions absent from the current Condition type, which only includes 'prone'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: it has the Frightened and Incapacitated conditions for 1 minute

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureMechanics: area attachment / multi-target
proposed_widenings.justification: Turn Undead targets all chosen Undead within 30 ft of the caster. ClassFeatureActivationMechanics has no attachment or target-scope field; it only carries a single ClassFeatureEffect with a fixed 'self' or 'target_creature' field.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each Undead of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw.

proposed_widenings.name: class_feature timed duration with complex break conditions
proposed_widenings.justification: Turn Undead's effect lasts 1 minute and ends early on three distinct conditions (creature takes damage; caster has Incapacitated; caster dies). ClassFeatureMechanics has no duration or early-break model.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This effect ends early on the creature if it takes any damage, if you have the Incapacitated condition, or if you die.

notes: Channel Divinity is a dispatch container: a single use-count pool that fans out to named sub-effects chosen at activation. This pattern has no representation in the current ClassFeatureMechanics family, which models a single fixed effect per activation. The partial_short_full_long reset cadence and ThresholdTiers<number> use-count cap are already present and would serve the pool header. The sub-effects (Divine Spark, Turn Undead) are tracked separately in the survey catalog (cleric_divine_spark). Even encoding a single sub-effect in isolation fails due to the missing 'action' activation cost and the missing damage/save_gate path in ClassFeatureEffect.
